text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll... I'll, I'll, I'LL DO IIIIIT!!
TAAAAAAAHHHHHH---!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You're finally here, Dotou!
I've been waiting for you, my destiny—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, I won't let you get ahead! I won't allow it!
Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Ah... that's right, that's how it was.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(My chest is burning. My inner self is trembling.
My heart leaps—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
('I'm the one,' 'I'm the one,' 'I'm gonna win!'
Competing against girls like that is—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh, haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah... haaah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Phew―――――.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Racing against my rivals...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It is utterly, irresistibly fun.
On the way home. Admire Vega suddenly paused at the entrance of Hanshin Racecourse and stood there motionless for a while.

As if slowly savoring
the excitement that has yet to cool down...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Ah, I'm sorry. Let's go.
choice_data_list: It's okay to take it slow.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I said forget about it already.
Though she said that, it seemed Admire Vega was still harboring something deep in her heart.
And then—
choice_data_list: Want to take a little detour on the way back?
Want to take a little detour on the way back?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...A detour?

Leaving Hanshin Racecourse, I walked for a bit. Before long,
I spotted a takoyaki stall
and decided to buy a pack.
Sitting on a bench, we shared the piping-hot takoyaki together—

A short while after the carton was empty,
a sudden thought struck me, and I broached the subject.
choice_data_list: Which race should we target next?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Next...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I was thinking.
About what it really means to 'be an older sister to be proud of.'"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What do I... want to become?
choice_data_list: Yeah. What do *you* want to do?
Yeah. What do *you* want to do?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I want to become a first-magnitude star.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I won't be outshone by any light running in this same era.
I will become a first-magnitude star, able to send its brilliance
to even the farthest reaches—places that might never be reached again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That much light.
That much glory... is what I want to obtain.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's why... yeah.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll truly enjoy racing, too.
I won't hold back those feelings anymore.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I will run in earnest, not as her stand-in,
but with the goal that 'I will win.'"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
“And victory, without fail.
I shall seize the glory of the first-magnitude star.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That is... the "proud big sister" I want to be.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"The 'person I want to be'—someone my little sister
can be endlessly proud of."

The new dream Admire Vega put forth.
As a step toward reaching the heavens,
what I want to propose is—
choice_data_list: What do you think about the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Fall Senior Triple Crown path...
A battle contending for the historic Autumn Shield...
choice_data_list: Surely worthy of adorning the brilliance of a first-magnitude star.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Right.
Let's go—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No, let me go.
To the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

Not to dedicate, nor because it was tasked,
but simply toward where her own heart and legs decided to go.

Following Admire Vega as she walks forward,
I firmly fix it in my mind.
The next goal is—the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"...And that concludes today's Takarazuka Kinen
highlights! Wow, what an absolute
thriller of a race that was!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "T.M. Opera O and Admire Vega both put on fantastic performances, of course... but to think Meisho Doto would join them in this battle!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"To think this was her very first GⅠ entry...
My word, it feels like we've witnessed a turning point in history!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...What an incredible race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Doto-chan, is al--
